cross_market_insights: The SERP is directories, venue listings, social pages and old blogs. In 16 organic top-3 slots, no planner or brand explains what a package is, what sits outside it, or how to compare two quotes.
Price-first framing everywhere: 'packages from', 'under AUD 10K', elopements under $1,200, PAA on the cheapest country. The bargain hunter owns this SERP; the AUD 150K+ couple is unserved.

The AI overview lists inclusions as four categories (venue, coordination, styling, food and drink). Nobody lists what packages leave out (guest accommodation, transfers, wet-weather plan, vendor meals, service charge and tax, legal paperwork, welcome and farewell events).
Nobody covers guest numbers versus package tiers, the wet season, or itemised quotes as a comparison method.
The legal question (symbolic in Bali vs legal Indonesian wedding) is absent from every top-3 page for this keyword.
Sydney and Melbourne lean on 2017 and 2022 content; Brisbane and Perth lean on listing pages. A dated, planning-led explainer has room in all four cities.
Intent mix: commercial investigation with transactional listings. A comparison-method explainer can win the 'how do we choose' lane without competing on price lists.
